verdict.rationale: Justworks provides Analytics/Custom Payroll Report exports and Xero integration mapping for reconciliation, and mentions an MCP offering, but there is no documented payroll journal API endpoint, no OpenAPI spec, and no evidence of agent-driven pull/reconcile workflows. missing for 10: documented payroll journal API/export endpoint, OpenAPI/API reference, evidence of agent or programmatic reconciliation into a ledger beyond Xero UI mapping.
